title: ConcreteVolumeOverride
description: ConcreteVolumeOverride: Overrides the concrete volume per unit area of a slab on deck, instead of calculating it from the slab properties. The volume of the deck is still calculated from the slab on deck properties.

VolumePerArea.description: Volume of concrete per unit area of the slab. Replaces the concrete volume otherwise derived from the slab on deck properties. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
